name: Arathi Basin
summary: In Arathi Basin, the League of Arathor and the Defilers fight over the valley's wealth. The League seeks to reclaim Arathor's lost lands for Stormwind, while the Forsaken aim to cut the humans off from their dwarven allies to the south. Its farm, stables, lumber mill, blacksmith and gold mine feed the war.

sections.title: The Larder of Arathor
sections.body:
Long before the Third War, Arathi Basin's fields, mills and mines fed Stromgarde, heir to ancient Arathor. When Lordaeron fell and Stromgarde crumbled, the valley was left almost undefended, though its farmsteads and workshops still stood.

Whoever holds them now commands grain, timber, iron and gold. Those stores keep an army in the field, and make this quiet valley one of the most fought-over places in the highlands.

sections.title: The League and the Defilers
sections.body:
The League of Arathor is an Alliance company formed from Stromgarde's survivors and their friends. Backed by Stormwind, they work from Refuge Pointe and have sworn to reclaim the lands their forebears built.

The Defilers are the Forsaken's answer: hardened troops of the Undercity under Varimathras's watchful eye. They fight alongside the Horde at Hammerfall. Their aim is to take the basin's riches and sever the road joining the northern humans to the dwarves of the south.

sections.title: Holding the Basin
sections.body:
Five strongpoints decide the battle: the farm, the stables, the lumber mill, the blacksmith and the gold mine. Each side races to raise its banner over them and defend what it claims. Every strongpoint held adds to its store of resources.

Raiders slip between the points to seize one while the enemy is busy elsewhere. The side that gathers enough resources first wins the basin, for a time.

faq.answer: Arathi Basin is a valley in the Arathi Highlands where the League of Arathor and the Forsaken Defilers fight for control. Its farm, stables, lumber mill, blacksmith and gold mine provide resources for the war.

faq.q: Who are the League of Arathor?
faq.answer: The League of Arathor is an Alliance company of Stromgarde's survivors and their allies. Backed by Stormwind and based at Refuge Pointe, they fight to reclaim Arathor's lost lands and the basin's riches.

The Defilers are elite Forsaken troops serving under the dreadlord Varimathras, Lady Sylvanas's lieutenant. They fight alongside the Horde at Hammerfall, seeking the basin's resources and a severed link between northern humans and their dwarven allies.

faq.q: Why do the Alliance and the Forsaken fight over Arathi Basin?
faq.answer: The basin's farms, mills and mines can feed and arm an army. For the League, taking it back advances the recovery of Arathor's lands; for the Defilers, it means denying resources to the humans and cutting them off from their dwarven allies to the south.

faq.q: How is the battle in Arathi Basin won?
faq.answer: Both sides fight to capture and hold the basin's five strongpoints: the farm, stables, lumber mill, blacksmith and gold mine. Each adds resources to its side, and the first to gather enough wins.

angles.text: Every strongpoint the League holds is a field of Arathor reclaimed, with grain and iron bound for Stormwind's soldiers.
Fighting beside the Defilers, the Horde drains the humans of needed resources and keeps them cut off from the dwarves to the south.
These farms once fed Stromgarde for generations. As a human, you see the basin as a home to take back, not a prize.
The Forsaken remember the living kingdoms that cast them out. As one of them, you may see taking the basin from Arathor's heirs as cold and fitting revenge.
